On the basis of the stress applied and the strain produced, there are three types of
moduli of elasticity:
a. Young’s Modulus of Elasticity ( Y):
It causes the deformation in the length of a body.
Therefore, the ratio of normal stress to the longitudinal strain produced is the
Young’s modulus of elasticity.
